boss.contribution: Read the ticket, cash position, and open queue; asked Inventory, Accounting, and Customer Service at once; wrote the plan: reply only, no override (no rate given) and no restock, with open questions on the rate and whether to quote all 20.

inventory.contribution: Found 8 of 20 size M on hand (shortfall 12) and the reprint vendor blocked by #501; asked Accounting about a 12-unit restock ($264).

customer_service.contribution: Drafted a reply with the $58 list price and 8 on hand, saying the discount is under review and asking for the needed-by date and size flexibility.

human_approvals.action: Send the drafted reply to Yale AI Club after human approval.
